reason_for_revision: The v1 probe result rows exposed label-bearing relative paths such as fake/... and real/.... The scorer did not read labels to make a decision, and its resource observations remain valid, but v2 removes those paths from public probe output before reconfirming the resource result.
purpose: Label-blind resource and deterministic-forward probe for FerretNet. This protocol cannot alter product scoring, thresholds, dependencies, or web behaviour.

upstream.license_evidence: Repository root LICENSE at the registered revision; the model file is tracked by that same revision.
upstream.weight_license_gate: Research-only probe is allowed because the checkpoint is tracked in the Apache-2.0 repository, but product use remains blocked until the authors explicitly confirm that the repository license grants use of the released checkpoint.

inference.input_preprocessing: official Test.yaml: CenterCrop(256), ToTensor(), Normalize(CLIP mean/std); no Grad-CAM, backward pass, CUDA, distributed setup, or automatic downloads
inference.score_semantics: sigmoid(logit) from the released checkpoint; a model output, not an AI probability

resource_probe.selection: first 12 manifest records in frozen manifest order; labels and source classes are not emitted in probe output or used for any decision

decision_policy.all_probe_gates_pass: confirm only CPU execution eligibility; product integration remains blocked
